en: A colorized vintage postcard view of a broad street or square in an old European coastal city. Stone townhouses with shuttered windows line both sides, leading the eye toward a large domed church in the background. The building has a green dome and classical details. People in traditional local clothing and period urban dress stand and walk through the square. Street lamps, potted trees, and stone pillars frame the scene. Printed captions in multiple languages appear at the bottom.
